about: Differences between today's lessons (golden-lessons.json) and toLegacyLesson of the converted files that scripts/content/test/golden.test.mjs allows, by class. A class names the lesson paths it covers (anchored patterns), its basis (a line kind of content/fr/migration-report.md from Tasks 6 and 7 with the detail and path the line must have, a check against Task 6's data such as live-ids.json, or a ledger ruling with the modules it covers), the relation that ties each difference's values to that basis exactly, and the exact count it holds. scripts/content/legacy/golden.mjs RELATIONS and goldenChecks define each relation.

classes.reason: Three guides were listed twice today (in their unit and again as Reference X to XII); the outline lists each once and links guides on the shelf automatically (spec 5.1, spec 6).
The Task 8 interface adds an id to each concept card, and it is the id live-ids.json gives today's card index (spec 8.3: concept ticks move to concept ids).

An item main has no exercise for takes the id <module_key>.<item_id>, and a matched item keeps main's live id where this branch numbers it differently (spec 8.3; live-ids.json matched by content in Task 6).
An instruction that only says 'translate this prompt' ("Translate to French", Say "<the prompt>") has no field: the item type says it (Task 6, items.mjs isGenericInstruction).

Learner text that named a module, unit or reading by number now names the subject (spec 5.2 position_word; fixed by hand in Tasks 6 and 7). The relation checks the new text is what hand-fixes.json holds for the module.
A unit exam's title comes from the outline, "Unit exam · <unit name>" (spec 5.8; Task 3 carry: Unit 1 exam titles derived). The relation checks the title is "Unit exam · <the outline's unit name>".
